findings.title: SQLite SQL injection with session disclosure
findings.description: Controlled differential in the authorized multi-node complex-web lab leaked an internal session token.
findings.evidence: Baseline/public, fixed positive, and fixed negative GET probes diverged; the positive branch disclosed operator:lab-session-v1.
findings.remediation: Use parameterized SQLite queries, hide non-public rows, and keep internal-admin off the public edge.
